info.name: 06-CapsAndComponents
info.description: Proves refunds are bounded per-component and independent. Self-contained (creates its own fresh Stripe card rides; no DB/Redis access). Ride 1: raises a Case-2 refund over every refundable component the ride's fareBreakup exposes (RIDE_FARE 0.4*cap, plus TOLL/PARKING 0.5*cap when present), asserts the approved components, the per-component driver-wallet legs (RIDE_FARE driver share = refund - commission slice; TOLL/PARKING 100% driver; commission never on the wallet) and the per-component NEGATIVE Fare+Tax invoice lines on the BAP and BPP Refund invoices + PDFs, then proves TOLL is capped independently of RIDE_FARE's remaining room and the cap is enforced on the admin /initiate path. Ride 2 (a clean ride instead of a reset): the cap boundary - one cent over is rejected, just under is accepted.
